groups: Cakka varaṃkita ratta supādo
His beautiful rosy feet are marked with the excellent wheel.
Lakkhaṇa maṇḍita āyata paṇhī
His long heels are adorned with auspicious marks.
Cāmara chatta vibhūsita pādo
His feet are adorned with marks of a chowrie and a parasol.
Esahi tuyha pitā narasīho
He, indeed, is your father, the lion of men.
Sakya kumāravaro sukhumālo
He is a noble, delicate prince of the Sakyan clan.
Lakkhaṇa vittita puṇṇa sarīro
His perfect body is adorned with auspicious marks.
Loka hitāya gato naravīro
The hero among men who has dedicated himself to the welfare of the world.
Esahi tuyha pitā narasīho
He, indeed, is your father, the lion of men.
Puṇṇa sasaṃka nibho mukha vaṇṇo
The complexion of his face is like the full moon.
Deva narāna piyo naranāgo
The elephant among men who is beloved by gods and humans.
Matta gajinda vilāsita gāmī
His gait is graceful like that of an intoxicated king of elephants.
Esahi tuyha pitā narasīho
He, indeed, is your father, the lion of men.
Khattiya sambhava agga kulīno
He is of the highest lineage, born into the royal warrior caste.
Deva manussa namassita pādo
His feet are worshipped by gods and humans.
Sīla samādhi patiṭṭhita citto
His mind is firmly established in morality and concentration.
Esahi tuyha pitā narasīho
He, indeed, is your father, the lion of men.
Āyata yutta susanṭhita nāso
His nose is long, well-proportioned, and beautifully shaped.
Gopabumo abhinīla sunetto
He has beautiful, deep blue eyes with eyelashes like those of a cow.
Indadhanū abhinīla bhamūko
His eyebrows are deep blue and shaped like a rainbow.
Esahi tuyha pitā narasīho
He, indeed, is your father, the lion of men.
Vaṭṭa sumaṭṭa susaṇṭhita gīvo
His neck is round, smooth, and well-formed.
Sīha hanū miga rāja sarīro
He has a jaw like a lion and a body like the king of beasts.
Kañcina succhavi uttama vaṇṇo
His beautiful skin has the supreme color of gold.
Esahi tuyha pitā narasīho
He, indeed, is your father, the lion of men.
Añjana vaṇṇa sunīla sukeso
His beautiful hair is deep black, the color of collyrium.
Kaṃcana paṭṭa visuddha laḷāṭo
His pure forehead is like a golden plate.
Osadhi paṇḍarasuddha suuṇho
The beautiful hair-tuft between his eyebrows is pure white like the morning star.
Esahi tuyha pitā narasīho
He, indeed, is your father, the lion of men.
Siniddha sugambhira manju sughoso
His voice is soft, deep, and beautifully resonant.
Hiṃgula baddha suratta sujivho
His beautiful tongue is deep red like polished vermilion.
Vīsati vīsati seta sudanto
He has beautiful white teeth, twenty in each row.
Esahi tuyha pitā narasīho
He, indeed, is your father, the lion of men.
Gacchati nīla pathe viya cando
He walks like the full moon traversing the blue sky.
Tāra gaṇā pariveṭhita rūpo
His form is surrounded by disciples like the moon is surrounded by stars.
Sāvaka majjhato samaṇindo
The lord of ascetics stands amidst his disciples.
Esahi tuyha pitā narasīho
He, indeed, is your father, the lion of men.
